teaser.en: A shrub whose white star-flowers have hairy, fringed petals, as if each one were edged with fine lace.
teaser.sw: Kichaka ambacho maua yake meupe yenye umbo la nyota yana petali zenye manyoya na pindo, kana kwamba kila moja limepambwa kwa lesi nyembamba.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chenye maruwa ga nyereru ga umbo ra nyota, ambago malage gana nyere kanda-kanda, dza kukala chila ruwa rikashonwa kanda-kanda kpwa nyuzi nyembamba.

summary.en: This mfyofyo is a shrub of the coffee family with white flowers whose petals are fringed with hairs. It shares its Digo name with Feretia apodanthera and Bourreria nemoralis.
summary.sw: Mfyofyo huu ni kichaka cha familia ya mibuni (kahawa) chenye maua meupe ambayo petali zake zina pindo la manyoya. Unashiriki jina lake la Kidigo na *Feretia apodanthera* na *Bourreria nemoralis*.
summary.dg: *Mfyofyo* uhu ni chitsaka cha jamii ya m'buni chenye maruwa ga nyereru, ambago malage gana nyere kanda-kanda. Unashiriki dzina ra Chidigo na *Feretia apodanthera* na *Bourreria nemoralis*.

about.en: *Heinsia crinita* is a shrub or small tree with leaves in opposite pairs. Its flowers are white and star-shaped, with five spreading lobes, and the upper surface of each lobe is covered with long, soft hairs. *Crinita* means 'long-haired'. The fruits are small, round and yellowish, crowned by the remains of the calyx. Digo people identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Heinsia crinita* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani yanayokaa kwa jozi zinazotazamana. Maua yake ni meupe na yenye umbo la nyota, yenye ndewe tano zilizotandazwa, na upande wa juu wa kila ndewe umefunikwa kwa manyoya marefu laini. *Crinita* maana yake ni 'mwenye nywele ndefu'. Matunda ni madogo, ya mviringo na ya rangi ya manjano-manjano, yakiwa na mabaki ya kikombe cha ua (calyx) juu yake. Wadigo hukitambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Heinsia crinita* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza ganayomera mairi-mairi ganalolana. Maruwage ni ga nyereru na ga umbo ra nyota, genye mala matsano ganayotandazika, na uphande wa dzulu wa chila chala una nyere nyire na laini. *Crinita* manage ni 'wenye nyere nyire'. Matunda ni madide, ga mviringo na ga rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu, na dzulu yakpwe kuna masaza ga *calyx*. Atu a Chidigo nkuumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in forest margins, thicket and bushland, across tropical Africa from West Africa to the East African coast.
where.sw: Hukua pembezoni mwa misitu, vichakani na katika nyika ya vichaka, kote katika Afrika ya tropiki kutoka Afrika Magharibi hadi pwani ya Afrika Mashariki.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya matsaka, vitsakani na weruni, kosi Afrika ya tsi za dzoho, kula Afrika ya Magharibi hadi pwani ya Afrika ya Mashariki.

uses.en: Pakia records no use. In West Africa the fruits are eaten and the young leaves are cooked as a vegetable, which is why it is called 'bush apple' there.
uses.sw: Pakia harekodi matumizi yoyote. Afrika Magharibi matunda yake huliwa na majani machanga hupikwa kama mboga, ndiyo maana huko huitwa *bush apple*.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi gogosi ga mmea uhu. Afrika ya Magharibi matundage nkuriwa na makodza maphya nkujitwa dza mboga, na ndiyo mana hiko unaihwa 'bush apple'.

names.en: Digo: *mfyofyo*, shared with Duruma according to Pakia, who gives no meaning. The same name covers *Feretia apodanthera* and *Bourreria nemoralis* (*mbunduchi*). No Swahili name is recorded. 'Bush apple' is a West African English name.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mfyofyo*, linaloshirikiwa na Kiduruma kwa mujibu wa Pakia, ambaye hatoi maana yake. Jina hilo hilo linajumuisha *Feretia apodanthera* na *Bourreria nemoralis* (*mbunduchi*). Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. *Bush apple* ni jina la Kiingereza la Afrika Magharibi.
names.dg: Chidigo: *mfyofyo*. Pakia anaamba Aduruma nao anahumira dzina hiri, ela kalavya manage. Dzina hiri hiri rinahumirwa kpwa *Feretia apodanthera* na *Bourreria nemoralis* (*mbunduchi*). Dzina ra Chiswahili tariphahikana. 'Bush apple' ni dzina ra Chingereza ra Afrika ya Magharibi.
